directories.description: The content of Reference Architecture and Guidance for Digital Public Infrastructure for the Health Sector — its document, chapters and blocks.

Source material, frozen. who-dpi-h-reference-architecture-draft-v1/ holds the review version exactly as circulated (line-numbered PDF and .docx), plus the extraction (docx-structure.json) and the page/line map (pdf-line-map.json) the folio and every public comment's anchor are derived from. Never edited to answer a comment.

The public-review record: one public-comment/1.0.0 file per comment (comments/PC-0042.json), one changeset/1.0.0 file per change-set (changesets/CS-012.json), one manifest per intake batch (batches/), and config.json naming the editors and review committee. A public comment is a todo kind, so anything that reads todos reads these. Moved only by folio-assistant-core/scripts/public-comment.ts. The original spreadsheets hold reviewers' emails and are NOT kept here.
Inbox for material not yet ingested.

The work plan: one bean per Markdown file (prefix dpi-h-ra-, per .beans.yml). Kept on the tip-keyed state branch cat/dpi-h-ra/beans, mounted here; owner decision 2026-10-06. Until the separate cutover removes beans/ from main, main's copy is the source of truth and the branch is a seed (manifest.json: status seed, authoritative false).

Todos: items, per-block feedback and review verdicts, as declared by todos/todos.json. Kept on the tip-keyed state branch cat/dpi-h-ra/todos, mounted here; owner decision 2026-10-06. Until the separate cutover removes todos/ from main, main's copy is the source of truth and the branch is a seed (manifest.json: status seed, authoritative false).
